# Screenshot Plan — LogParser Pro

## Screenshots

### 1. Syntax Highlighting
**Title:** Color-Coded Log Levels at a Glance
**What to capture:** A log file open in the dedicated editor showing color-coded lines — red for ERROR, orange for WARN, blue for INFO, gray for DEBUG. Use a real-world log with mixed levels to show the visual contrast.

### 2. Log Level Filtering
**Title:** Filter by Severity with One Click
**What to capture:** The filtering panel active with only ERROR selected, showing a dramatically reduced view of the log. Include the filter toggles for each level and the result count.

### 3. Pattern Matching and Search
**Title:** Regex Search with Result Highlighting
**What to capture:** A regex search active in the log editor with matched patterns highlighted in the log content. Show the search bar with a pattern and the highlighted results in context.

### 4. Stack Trace Folding
**Title:** Collapse Stack Traces for Readability
**What to capture:** A log file with a Java exception showing both a folded stack trace (single collapsed line with expand indicator) and an expanded trace below it for comparison.

### 5. LogParser Pro Tool Window
**Title:** Log Analysis Dashboard
**What to capture:** The LogParser Pro tool window at the bottom of the IDE showing the main analysis view with open log files, source connections, and analysis controls.

### 6. Correlation ID Tracking (Pro)
**Title:** Trace Requests Across Microservices
**What to capture:** The correlation ID tracking view showing a unified transaction timeline with entries from multiple services (e.g., api-gateway, user-service, payment-service) linked by a single correlation ID.

### 7. Kubernetes Log Tailing (Pro)
**Title:** Real-Time Kubernetes Pod Logs in Your IDE
**What to capture:** The Connect Log Source dialog showing Kubernetes pod selection, and the live-tailing view showing streaming log output from a running pod.

### 8. AI Anomaly Detection (Pro)
**Title:** ML-Powered Anomaly Detection
**What to capture:** The anomaly detection view highlighting unusual log patterns flagged by the Isolation Forest algorithm, with anomaly scores and visual indicators marking the suspicious entries.
